desc: The SAR9 SubCompact GEN2 gives you the concealment, capacity and comfort you need for all day carry. This subcompact was originally designed and engineered for special forces around the world. With a capacity of 12 rounds, this pistol features a polymer grip module that is manufactured to the highest standards. Featuring a barrel and slide created from forged steel alloy, striker fired single action technology, a striker and trigger safety, designed to minimize recoil for quick follow-up shots. Includes two magazines.
